directive_events.owner_directive: Data types tab: type tiles look identical to block tiles, so they read as draggable into the workflow. Render types as a list instead - one row per type, colour swatch as a framed square left of the name, parent type in grey on the right.
directive_events.reason: Owner review of the running desktop build redirected the Data types tab presentation

directive_events.owner_directive: After Save to My Library, a block or type has its name auto-filled into the search box; users are confused about why they cannot find anything else. Remove that behaviour.
directive_events.reason: Owner review of the running desktop build removed the post-promotion palette filter

directive_events.owner_directive: A type I just created never shows up no matter how I reload. Also: users may double-click a type and find nothing there - make double-click open that type's source. Core and package types must be read-only; user-library and project types editable.
directive_events.reason: Owner review of the running desktop build: Reload did not rescan, and a type row answered a double click with nothing

directive_events.owner_directive: What is saved into My Library should be moved there outright - clear it out of the project. Blocks and types must behave the same.
directive_events.reason: Owner reversed FR-017 after seeing copied types shadowed by their project originals
